description_en: Modifies the name and description of an IPv6 address
description_zh: 修改IPv6地址的名称和描述
kebab_example: aliyun vpc modify-ipv6-address-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ipv6-address-id ipv6-hp32vv2klzw4yerdf0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyIpv6AddressAttribute

parameters.help_en: The region where the IPv6 address is located. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html to obtain the region ID
parameters.help_zh: IPv6地址所在的地域。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the IPv6 address
parameters.name: ipv6_address_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the IPv6 address.

The name must be 0 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
IPv6地址的名称。

长度为0-128个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the IPv6 address.

The description must be 0 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
IPv6地址的描述信息。

长度为0-256个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run without actually modifying the IPv6 address. The system checks the required parameters, request format, and service limits. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check succeeds, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.
false (default): performs a dry run and sends the request. If the check succeeds, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会查询可使用的IP地址池信息。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may vary for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token
